title: Expro Commences $380 Million Project to Boost Algeria’s Oil and Gas Production
summary: New agreement sees Expro deploy advanced production technologies and integrated service solutions aimed at improving efficiency and supporting Algeria’s…
body_markdown:
Expro hascommenced operations under a four-year contract worth approximately $380 million by a major North African operator to deliver production optimization and well management services across multiple fields.


The new agreement sees Expro deploy advanced production technologies and integrated service solutions aimed at improving efficiency and supporting Algeria’s ongoing drive to increase output. The award represents one of Expro’s largest contracts in North Africa to date.


Alistair Geddes, Chief Operating Officer at Expro said: *“This platform builds on more than a decade of collaboration with our client and reflects the strength of our partnership in delivering safe, efficient production solutions. We’re proud to continue supporting Algeria’s energy ambitions with systems designed to sustain output, maximize uptime and reduce operating costs.*


*“It also reinforces our ability to respond quickly to a changing market and operational environment, driving performance and innovation across one of North Africa’s most important energy regions.”*


The contract covers multiple projects, each requiring rapid mobilization of equipment and expertise to key developments, aligning with the client’s focus on safety, operational efficiency, and sustainable production.


The award reinforces Expro’s role as a key energy services partner in Algeria and highlights its growing contribution to production performance across North Africa and the wider MENA region.
